headline: Week ten: B2B delivered in the Lakes, calf quiet again
narrative: The assignment was the first proper back-to-back weekend, and it arrived a day early: two consecutive Lakeland days over the 4 Passes — Scafell Pike and Broad Crag Col on day one, a wild camp in Ennerdale, then Scarth Gap and Honister to close it out. Those two days did most of the climbing and carried the week comfortably past its vert target, with time on feet finishing over the ask too. The run/hike blend showed up as well: Monday's club run and a dawn trail outing over Sponds Hill and Higher Moor kept the running thread alive around the big hiking days, which is exactly what the week called for.

Third straight week without a word from the calf — the reintroduction has held through genuinely big terrain now. Cumulatively the build toward Costa Blanca is tracking well, with Build phase stacking on schedule. Next week ramps it: more vert, more hours, and a longer back-to-back. Sunday's full rest after the camp was the right call; keep protecting that recovery as the loads climb.
